lines.en: : Sensei, good. Do you mind if I ask you for your thoughts on sexual torture devices?
lines.zh: : Sensei，正好。介意我问问你对性虐器具的看法吗？

lines.en: : It shouldn't take long, but I'd like to know if your thoughts on the matter match my own.
lines.zh: : 不会占用太久，但我想知道你对这事的看法是不是跟我一致。

lines.en: I spend several minutes trying to figure out why Nodoka wants to talk about such a thing before I chalk it up to just being on account of her...being Nodoka.
lines.zh: 我花了几分钟试图搞明白 Nodoka 为什么想聊这个，最后把它归结为——因为她……就是 Nodoka。

lines.en: It's best to not get in her way when she's dead set on talking about something.
lines.zh: 她一旦打定主意要聊什么，最好不要挡她的路。

lines.en: Even if that something is a thing that would make the vast majority of people uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 哪怕那个话题能让绝大多数人浑身不自在。

lines.en: But hey, she definitely could have chosen worse fetishes.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她本来完全可以选更糟糕的癖好。

lines.en: : Sensei, good. Do you mind if I ask you for your thoughts on cows?
lines.zh: : Sensei，正好。介意我问问你对牛的看法吗？

lines.en: : I think they're up to something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它们在谋划什么。

lines.en: To Nodoka's dismay, I don't have many thoughts on her topic of choice.
lines.zh: 让 Nodoka 失望的是，对她选的这个话题我没什么想法。

lines.en: She, however, walks the fine line between loving and hating it, apparently.
lines.zh: 不过她自己显然在「爱」与「恨」之间走钢丝。

lines.en: I'd love to tell you which parts she enjoys and which parts she doesn't-
lines.zh: 我很想告诉你她享受哪部分、不享受哪部分——

lines.en: But frankly, she names so many devices that I've never even heard of that I don't want to mix anything up.
lines.zh: 但说实话，她报出的一堆器具我听都没听过，我不想搞混。

lines.en: Regardless, the conversation comes to an abrupt and awkward end as the two of us ultimately decide to head back to our respective beds.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这场对话在尴尬中戛然而止，我俩最终各自回各自的床上去了。

lines.en: Albeit with one of us significantly less aroused than the other.
lines.zh: 只不过其中一个人的兴奋程度明显低于另一个。

lines.en: Nodoka and I...talk about cows, I guess?
lines.zh: 我和 Nodoka……聊了聊牛，大概吧？
